The '''Dankayo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]], which was home to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Dankayo Base|base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], which was [[Battle of Dankayo|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SH" />
